title: Pear German Delight
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional German cuisine, inspired by the flavors of China.

ingredients.name: Pears
ingredients.notes: Any variety, but firmer ones work best

instructions: 2. Slice the pears into thin wedges.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the German mustards and a pinch of salt.
4. Arrange the pear slices on top of the German dark rye bread.
5. Drizzle the mustard mixture over the pears.
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the pears are tender and the bread is toasted.
8. Garnish with a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.
